faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Part-time Doctor position at RCB?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Part-time Doctor position at the Regional Centre for Biotechnology is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Part-time Doctor role?
faq.answer: The essential educational qualification for the Part-time Doctor post is MBBS. An MD degree is considered desirable for this position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Part-time Doctor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Part-time Doctor position in the Regional Centre for Biotechnology recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Part-time Doctor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Part-time Doctor position will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Part-time Doctor position at RCB should be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Part-time Doctor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Part-time Doctor recruitment at RCB primarily involves CV screening.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Part-time Doctor post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Part-time Doctor position.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Regional Centre for Biotechnology located?
faq.answer: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology is located in Faridabad, Haryana.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with an MD degree apply?
faq.answer: Yes, an MD degree is considered desirable for the Part-time Doctor position, in addition to the essential MBBS qualification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for the RCB Part-time Doctor recruitment can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
